imagePrompts.rock: Scientific-educational production asset for a 3D exoplanet simulator. One seamless full-globe equirectangular diffuse ALBEDO atlas, 2:1 panoramic landscape, ideally 3072 by 1536 or higher. Edge-to-edge rectangular orthographic unwrapped planetary terrain, all pixels are surface. Artist's impression, spacecraft geological mapping detail: complex ancient ochre basaltic highlands, dark flood basalts, branching pale mineral outcrops, overlapping degraded impact basins, a few fresh radial ejecta, varied crater scales, mountain chains with intermittent sharp scarps and winding rifts. A few large quiet plains next to intricate rough regions. Subdued warm grey and rust umber, accurate subtle tonal changes, clear large features readable on a sphere at small sizes, huge wealth of crisp fine detail when enlarged. Fine rock texture not photographic noise. Longitude must wrap from left to right. Both poles continuous in equirectangular projection. Flat neutral illumination with no global cast shadows, no atmosphere, no day/night, no horizon, no curved globe, no ocean or foliage, no sky, no grid or typography, no borders. Single texture map.
imagePrompts.ice: Scientific-educational production asset for a 3D exoplanet simulator. Varied regions of slate mineral plates under blue-grey fractured glacial ice, several vast brighter pale ivory frost sheets, intricate branching cyan and charcoal fissures at multiple scales, weathered impact basins and long glacier corridors, quiet smooth areas beside layered chaotic terrain. Restrained cool mineral blue, dark umber ground, off-white frost, subtle realistic colour separation like natural-colour satellite mosaics. Single atlas, no blank margins, stars, labels, grid lines, letters, borders or decorative overlay. Output ideally 3072 by 1536 or larger.
imagePrompts.gas: Scientific-educational reusable gas giant cloud material for a realistic 3D exoplanet simulator. Calm broad smooth regions between very detailed eddies, balanced contrast, no repeating ring motif. High acuity. Nondirectional even lighting, purely reflectance; no global shadows, no sphere, no outer space, no sunset, no view of a disk. No grid, frame, labels, typography or watermarks. Ideally 3072 by 1536 or higher.
imagePrompts.coast: Scientific-educational production material. Single equirectangular global albedo map 2:1 (wide landscape), edge-to-edge rectangular, to wrap an artist's-impression TRAPPIST-1e on a real-time sphere. Hypothetical temperate rocky surface: three unequal continents with recognizably non-Earth silhouettes, long broken volcanic islands, subtle mountain folds, rust ochre stripped-soil highlands and desaturated slate estuaries, moderately luminous deep mineral-teal seas and a few intricate turquoise shelves, small pale high-latitude ice. About 48% open water, 52% land. No vegetation, urban lights or buildings. Richly resolved geological detail like natural-color spacecraft mapping, sophisticated subdued photographic colours, distinctive continent-scale structure to read from afar, no exaggerated contrast. Important: cloud-free map; our renderer adds its own moving clouds. Uniform nondirectional lighting, no terminator, darkening or globe silhouette. The left and right edges must join seamlessly, and polar texture should be stretched laterally as in equirectangular projection. No text, grids, margin or sky. High resolution.
